title: QBIND Public DevNet Retained Anchor-Drift History Diff
description: Canonical, publish-safe schema for the LOCAL historical comparison of two retained Run 407-style ANCHOR_DRIFT_REPORT.json artifacts (each valid under PACKAGE_INTEGRITY_ANCHOR_DRIFT_REPORT.schema.json). The diff is GENERATED TRANSIENTLY at comparison time into a directory OUTSIDE the package tree and is NOT committed. It records the per-count delta and per-array path delta (added/removed full-tree-only paths, new/cleared missing anchors, new/cleared undocumented mismatches, and changed documented refreshes) between a base report and a candidate report, plus an overall verdict. It is docs/artifact only: it embeds NO binary blob, NO secret, NO private path/hostname/endpoint, NO raw log, NO raw /metrics dump, and NO generated private identity. The comparator NEVER fetches CI artifacts automatically and NEVER requires a token or secret; the operator downloads the two reports manually. This diff is NOT a signed attestation, NOT binary provenance, and NOT launch evidence. It moves NO readiness item: M4 stays Yellow, M6 stays Yellow/Partial, S5/S7 stay Yellow, public DevNet stays NOT launch-ready, and C4/C5 stay OPEN.

reportRef.description: Identity + counts of one retained Run 407-style ANCHOR_DRIFT_REPORT.json input. No filesystem path, no timestamp source of truth, and no free-form label are embedded.

diff_version.description: Diff schema version (semver of this schema contract).

generated_for_run.description: The QBIND run number this diff schema was introduced for. Fixed to 408.

scope.description: Stable scope tag for this diff. Historical comparison of two anchor-drift reports only.

package_root.description: Repository-relative root of the documented public DevNet package. All relative_path values are resolved against this root. Never an absolute path.

generated_at_utc.description: OPTIONAL UTC timestamp (ISO-8601, Zulu) when this diff was generated. Informational only.

safety_labels.description: Standing safety labels this diff carries. All required labels must be present.

count_delta.description: Per-count integer delta (candidate minus base). A value of 0 means the count is unchanged. Values may be negative (candidate lower than base).

path_delta.description: Per-array path delta between base and candidate, using safe relative paths only. Added/removed full-tree-only paths are expected curated-anchor drift; new missing anchors and new undocumented mismatches are failures; cleared arrays record failures that went away; changed documented refreshes record deliberate-refresh set changes.

verdict.description: Overall comparison verdict. Only positive-no-new-failures is a PASS; the three negative verdicts fail closed.

non_claims.description: Explicit non-claim booleans. Every field must be exactly false (this diff makes none of these claims).

artifact_safety_label.description: Standing human-readable safety label this diff carries.
artifact_safety_label.const: experimental · resettable · no value · no uptime SLA · NOT public-DevNet launch-ready · no MainNet readiness claim · no C4/C5 closure claim
